geopolitics_summary: EU faces summer heat-driven nuclear/grid stress, winter gas storage risk, and potential US Russia sanctions escalation affecting LNG costs.

themes.headline: German gas reserves face winter shortage risk; EU storage fill urgency critical
themes.why_it_matters: Low EU gas storage heading into winter raises forward curve risk (Cal+1, Cal+2). TTF upside if reserve targets missed; power exposure via gas-to-power switching. Direct desk relevance.

themes.headline: French nuclear plant jellyfish invasion; recurring summer cooling-water disruption pattern
themes.why_it_matters: Structural summer nuclear outage risk in France (EU's largest nuclear exporter). Reduces baseload supply; forces expensive gas-fired generation and power price spikes during peak demand. DA/week-ahead power curve bullish.

themes.headline: US Senate passes Russia sanctions bill; House vote pending September, LNG cost implications
themes.why_it_matters: Further Russia sanctions risk tightening global LNG supply to EU. Higher LNG import costs flow directly to TTF arb, lifting European gas and power curves (Cal+1 onwards). Monitor House vote in September.

themes.headline: Europe's summer heat erases growth; demand destruction in Netherlands, France contraction risk
themes.why_it_matters: Economic contraction cuts industrial power/gas demand. Structural downside to Cal+1 curves; offset partially by lower storage fills and nuclear outages. Net macro pressure is bearish power near-term.

themes.headline: Italy increases green energy and defense spending after EU fiscal rule relaxation
themes.why_it_matters: Higher EU renewable capex supply growth structural headwind to power prices. Indirect but meaningful for medium-term (Cal+2 onwards) pricing; adds to supply-side capacity.

watchlist: House vote on Russia sanctions bill (September 2026) — escalates LNG cost risk to EU.
EU gas storage fill rates through August–September — winter adequacy critical for TTF curve.
French nuclear unit restart timelines post-jellyfish incidents — baseload supply recovery tracking.
Italy green energy capex deployment milestones — medium-term renewable generation ramp tracking.
